description: Cargo fragment. Four of the five Rust repos are Cargo workspaces (logmole, mcp-servers,
stintlab, tablero, fontes-antiquae), so a single group keeps one PR per workspace rather than
one per member crate. security:minimumReleaseAgeCrate adds the crates.io quarantine window on

packageRules.description: One PR per workspace for every non-major crate change.
Dev-dependencies (criterion, proptest, insta …) never reach the shipped binary.
Build-dependencies affect what gets compiled into the artifact — keep them out of the dev group.
